fusions.name: Next Course Served
fusions.desc: Serves the next course on the written menu into the first enemy it meets for 8 damage, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Eat Your Words
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Devours every affliction you have written on the target, dealing 18 damage plus 1.8 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Grace Said Aloud
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. It grows 10% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Food for Thought
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
